items.title: DALI Alliance announces DALI 27 Inaugural Global Summit + Expo
items.summary: DALI Alliance will hold its first Global Summit and Expo, DALI 27, in Utrecht in February 2027, gathering lighting, smart-building and smart-city stakeholders around the DALI control protocol.

items.title: Product Monday: Venetian Blinds Upcycled Into Luminaires
items.summary: A designer has repurposed reclaimed aluminium venetian blind slats into a modular luminaire family, using the slats' inherent shading geometry to direct and diffuse light output rather than block daylight.

items.title: London Aquatics Centre upgrades to next-generation LED lighting with Signify
items.summary: Signify has upgraded London Aquatics Centre's LED lighting to meet World Aquatics broadcast standards, citing up to 60% energy savings at full output and using AR-assisted aiming to handle the venue's complex geometry.
